display_long_description:
**Pets & Stuff** – a cute, fun and relaxing game where you become a skillful groomer and veterinarian. Help little friends in trouble, make them happy, pampered, clean, well-fed, and don't forget to add a pinch of chic. Let your imagination run wild!

Enjoy a fully responsive and polished gameplay, make the best trims, feel the fur at your fingertips and capture the best photoshoots of your creations. 

**Meet a wide range of pets**
[media]

Help a variety of furry friends in need: cats, dogs, raccoons, foxes, deer and so many more!

**Explore tools and accessories**
[media]

From fly swatters to vacuum cleaners, you'll have a range of tools to take care of each pet. Use color sprays, collars and shades for a stylish finish!

**Upgrade your clinic and discover new locations**
[media]

Discover all four unique locations—Clinic, Forest, Farm, and Fantasy Land—and earn stars to upgrade your workspace to a cozy clinic!

Cuteness overload and furrrr everywhere guaranteed!
